solarData.name: Monocrystalline Solar Panels
solarData.description: High-efficiency panels with 20-22% efficiency. Ideal for residential rooftops with limited space. Perfect for home installations where maximum output is needed from a small area.

solarData.name: Polycrystalline Solar Panels
solarData.description: Cost-effective panels with 15-17% efficiency. Suitable for large-scale agricultural applications like water pumping systems where space isn't a constraint.

solarData.name: Thin-Film Solar Panels
solarData.description: Lightweight and flexible panels with 10-13% efficiency. Excellent for schools and hospitals with curved roofs or irregular surfaces. Low maintenance solution for public institutions.

solarData.name: Solar Street Lights
solarData.description: All-in-one lighting systems for public spaces. Automatic dusk-to-dawn operation. Perfect for school campuses, hospital parking lots, and municipal areas.

solarData.name: Solar Microgrid System
solarData.description: Complete energy independence solution for villages and institutions. Combines solar panels, batteries, and smart controllers. Ensures 24/7 power for critical facilities like hospitals.
